Meeting 1/2569 · Subcommittee on Whole-System Water Management, Pollution and Environment
Managing pollution and the environment after the floods in Bangkok
se: The meeting studied how to manage pollution and the environment after the floods in Bangkok. The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration, Lat Krabang District Office, Khlong Sam Wa District Office, the Environment Department and the Health Department were invited to give information. The meeting heard about restoring the environment and handling waste and sewage after the floods, with damage of more than 7,000 million baht, help for affected residents, lessons from the floods, care for people's physical and mental health, ways to prevent infectious diseases after the floods, and the work in Lat Krabang and Khlong Sam Wa districts.
it: Restoring the environment, handling waste and sewage after the floods, help for residents and lessons learned (Bangkok Metropolitan Administration)
Physical and mental health care and preventing infectious diseases after the floods (Health Department)
Waste handling and help for residents in Lat Krabang and Khlong Sam Wa districts

te: Meeting summary video · Managing pollution and the environment after the floods in Bangkok
Water pollution and floods in Prachin Buri
se: The meeting studied ways to prevent and solve water pollution in Prachin Buri: dark water flowing from flooded areas through the Phet Oem water gate and Bueng Nong Bon into the Prachin Buri River, an oil-like film on the water flowing into Bueng Nong Bon and public water sources, and flooding in Ban Sang district. The Ministry of Industry, the Department of Health, the Pollution Control Department and Wang Dan Subdistrict Administrative Organization were invited to give information. The meeting heard the results of water quality checks and analysis, ways to find the cause and source of pollution, oversight of factories under the law, assessment of health effects, and disclosure of information to the public.
it: Water pollution in Prachin Buri: dark water from flooded areas, and an oil-like film in Bueng Nong Bon and public water sources
Flooding in Ban Sang district, water quality results, finding pollution sources, and assessing health effects

Preparing a seminar on disaster response systems, and approving 2 draft reports
se: The meeting prepared a seminar on developing disaster response and decision support systems, to be held on Friday 27 November 2026, and approved 2 draft reports: the study report on solving illegal dumping of industrial waste, plastic waste, hazardous waste and electronic waste, and the report on developing a single decision support system (Single DSS). The next meeting was set for 29 October 2026 to consider preventing and solving water pollution in Prachin Buri.
it: Preparing a seminar on developing disaster response and decision support systems (27 November 2026)
Draft study report on solving illegal dumping of industrial waste, plastic waste, hazardous waste and electronic waste
Draft report on developing a single decision support system (Single DSS)

te: Meeting summary video · Preparing a seminar on disaster response systems, and approving 2 draft reports
Managing water in a crisis in Bangkok and its vicinity
se: The meeting studied water management in a crisis in Bangkok and its vicinity, discussing 5 matters: preparation before an event, response and communication in a crisis, town plans and water plans in Bangkok, the clarity of warnings, and coordination between agencies to build public confidence.
it: Water management in a crisis in Bangkok and its vicinity: preparation, communication, town and water plans, warnings, and coordination between agencies
